summary: QuickEntryPlacing handles the workflow for creating and placing placement requests (PRs) in the HSPnet system using a quick entry interface. It manages the selection and validation of agencies, departments, programs, sites, services, destinations, courses, instructors, placement coordinators, students, dates, shift codes, times, group sizes, and other request details. The screen enables rapid entry while upholding business rules and validation logic for placements across multiple entities, supporting both group and individual PR types.
purpose: To quickly create and place placement requests by capturing essential information about placing and receiving agencies, departments, programs, courses, contacts, scheduling, group size, request codes, and comments. Provides server-side validation and business logic to ensure valid and complete requests.

workflows.name: Quick Entry Placement Request Creation
steps: User loads QuickEntryPlacing screen (defaults and session variables are applied)
User selects/inputs placing agency, department, program, receiving agency, site, service, and destination
User selects placement coordinator, instructor, service contact, and destination contact
User selects course, program year, and group size
User assigns students (add/unassign)
User specifies project title, destination details, request codes
User selects options for NIS, IRP, PA breaks
User specifies reply-by date, start date, end date, shift code, times, days, various days/times
User enters shift length, shift count, duration hours
User adds comments, chooses to show comments, enters alert
User selects action (Outbox, Send to Receiving Agency)
Server-side validation: checks required fields and business rules
If valid, placement request is created and user notified
If errors, screen shows messages and reloads assigned students

workflows.name: Dropdown Population and Dependency Workflow
steps: Dropdowns for department, program, to-agency, site, service, destination populated based on prior selections and session values
Contacts and staff search for placement coordinator, instructor, service and destination contacts based on agency and service/destination
Request codes, course info, program years pulled from appropriate lists/functions
On change of dropdown, dependent fields and options are refreshed

workflows.name: Validation Workflow
steps: Validate all required fields: program, site, service, course, program year, placement coordinator, start/end dates, duration
Validate date fields (start, end, reply-by), times (24hr, shift code matching), group size, student assignment
Perform calculations (shift length from start/end time, duration hours from shift count and shift length)
Enforce business rules for NIS/IRP/PA breaks based on program flags
Show/hide fields and controls based on context (service/destination contacts, request dropdown visibility, NIS/IRP/PA breaks)

business_rules: Program, site, service, course, program year, placement coordinator are mandatory
Start and end dates must be valid and end date must follow start date
Reply-by date must be valid and before start date
Duration hours and shifts must be numeric and not zero
Group size must be greater than or equal to student count if course is Group type
If department uses shift codes, only show shift fields, otherwise show start/end time fields
Placement coordinator defaults to current user if not selected
Request codes shown/hidden based on program
NIS/IRP/PA breaks visibility depends on program and user session
validations: Required field checks (program, site, service, course, program year, placement coordinator)
Date/time validation (start/end/reply-by dates, 24hr format, valid period)
calculations: Shift length calculated from start/end times if not provided
Duration hours calculated from shift count and shift length if not provided
Student count calculated from assigned students
conditions: Show/hide request dropdown based on program
Show/hide NIS/IRP/PA breaks checkboxes based on program/user
Show service/destination contact input fields only if no contact is found
Shift codes dropdown shown if department uses shift codes, otherwise show time fields
system_behavior: Dropdowns auto-populate based on session and previous selections
Validation errors shown in error panel; screen reloads students after error
Session variables saved/unloaded across page actions
On Save, placement request is created (QESCreatePARequest) and user receives feedback/warning
dependencies: Dropdown population depends on agency, department, program, site, service, destination selections
Contact selection/search depends on agency, service, destination
Program flags drive visibility of NIS/IRP/PA breaks
Client-side JavaScript controls various behaviors (duration, shift length calculation, comments visibility, student reload)
exceptions: Service/destination contact not found triggers input fields for manual entry
Invalid start/end dates, times, shift values, group sizes, or missing students trigger error messages and prevent save
If group size is 1 and course type isn't Group, with 1 student, group size reset to null to avoid incorrect PR creation
content_gaps: No detailed field-level descriptions for all dropdowns and hidden fields.
Exact error message text is resource-based and not listed.
No detailed UI mock-ups or client-side JavaScript code for some dynamic screen controls.
Underlying database schema details and code for QESCreatePARequest not included.
